description: This PHP source file defines a ValidationDecorator class that provides methods to apply validation rules to parameter objects within a validation framework. It includes methods to enforce required and optional parameter rules with customization for handling empty strings.

classes.name: ValidationDecorator
classes.description: A helper class to apply validation rules to parameters, facilitating required and optional validation configurations.

methods.name: requiredParamRule
methods.description: Configures a ParamRule object to be required, with optional exclusion of empty strings, and applies rules accordingly.

methods.name: notRequiredParamRule
methods.description: Configures a ParamRule object to be optional, with an option to consider empty strings as acceptable or null.
